environment_preparation.binding: derive new per-provider bindings from accepted SQLite v3 Workload replay-2; only command_env.TIME_STYLE and one adaptation note change

environment_preparation.native_image: explicit preflight observation candidate digest; default version catalogs unchanged
environment_preparation.sqlite_toolchain: unchanged existing general toolchain; no prebuilt task answer
environment_preparation.overrides: native per-command environment and explicit GNU ls --time-style override the default; stat remains available
environment_preparation.scope: all GNU ls processes inheriting binding defaults, including preparation/verification commands

acceptance: new real autonomous Agent recording passes the original independent verifier
new Tape complete; same full request/history Strict matching; real tools execute again
at least two new-Sandbox replays plus same-Tape Huawei/E2B comparison after independent preparation
preserve all failed, canceled and unstarted attempts; no post-hoc Tape or matcher edits
same CPU/memory, variant, Tape and placement; report disk/platform differences without disqualifying solely for those differences
confirm stop/revocation, private verification and owned Sandbox cleanup; keep missing timing absent
limits: not an unchanged official benchmark submission
a stable logical handle is not a real PID; child output can still be dynamic
native poll/log/PTY remain available and may produce non-repeatable live results
raw job evidence is not automatically an analyzed Trace or complete process-call coverage
preparation, runtime, model wait, tool work and independent verification have distinct measured boundaries
names-only discovery does not make unrelated platform-generated names reproducible; inspect the task-relevant scope

the native optional wait timeout and live polling remain available with real timing-dependent outcomes; v4 retains the v2 guidance directing finite-work comparisons to omit the wait timeout but does not enforce compliance or normalize results
new public instructions require one new qualified real recording; v1/v2/v3 tapes cannot validate v4
retaining logs in the workspace does not automatically export or archive every workspace log; no new log collector is introduced
redirection and real log-reading tools change observable workload and model context; keep v4 timing/statistics separate
public guidance cannot guarantee Agent compliance or byte equality of task-required diagnostic output; Strict matching remains unchanged
TIME_STYLE is a native GNU ls display option; it does not guarantee other tool output or explicit timestamp reads are deterministic
old v3 Strict failure and all original materials/Tapes/results remain unchanged
new native preflight observer closes only its verified boundary and does not change the terminal-result protocol
